citationText: 7. Chrétien also delivered a paper on the potential use of anamorphic optics in film to the Academy of Sciences on May 30, 1927, and to the Optical Society of America in November 1928. Chrétien later gave a demonstration of his lens at the Palace of Light in the Paris Exposition of 1937. The paper by Chrétien and others that accompanied this demonstration was published in the J. SMPE , 37, (May 1939). According to internal correspondence at Fox, it was through this article that Chrétien's work came to the attention of Earl Sponable and Herbert Bragg of Fox's Research Dept.
